paper_id: Learning Representation over Dynamic Graph using Aggregation-Diffusion Mechanism
title: Learning Representation over Dynamic Graph using Aggregation-Diffusion Mechanism
motivation: 信息聚合机制导致动态图更新延迟，影响性能
problem_framing: 将延迟问题形式化为聚合路径上的信息积累滞后
key_insight: 在聚合后主动将变化传播给邻居，弥补非交互事件时的信息空白
method_signature: 在TPP模型后增加扩散步骤，触发时同步更新邻居
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 多跳扩散反而降低性能；注意力机制效果不稳健
evidence_for_taste: Diffusing more hops...doesn't result in improved performance
repeatedly obtaining information through diffusion will lead to negative effect
The more hops of diffusion, the greater the risk and amount of noise
LDG-AD-delta have a significant performance decline
attention mechanism is still meaningful...explore a more suitable attention mechanism
thinking_moves: 从具体案例fig1反推聚合机制的延迟本质
通过消融实验系统分离聚合和扩散的贡献
用图平均路径长度解释扩散跳数的负效应
跨数据集对比揭示方法局限性（Social Evolution vs Github）
